newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume drops as prices rise.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume drops as prices rise.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange shrank to 790 kg on Tuesday from Monday's 1,072 kg in subdued trade as players remained on the sidelines, awaiting direction in world markets, dealers said.
Gold closed higher at $340.00 an ounce and 1,600,500 lira per gram, compared to $338.00 and 1,590,500 lira on Monday, following firmer levels on European markets.
Most of the day's trade -- 660 kg -- took place in the morning and 58.9 percent of the total trade was done in lira.
